newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler offers $400 college student rebate.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler offers $400 college student rebate.

text.p: Chrysler Corp., moving to attact college-age buyers, said Tuesday it is mailing 1.9 million certificates to college and graduate students that offer a $400 rebate on any 1996, 1997 or 1998 Chrysler vehicle.
The rebates, valid through December 31, 1997, are in addition to any existing national consumer incentives, Chrysler said.
Darrell Watts, Chrysler's manager of owner communications, said the college rebate will boost discounts available to students on the Dodge and Plymouth Neon to $1,400.

The rebates are available to all 1995, 1996 or 1997 graduates of two-year, four-year or post graduate degrees from an accredited college, university, U.S. service academy, or registered nursing program.
They also are available to students currently enrolled in a master's or doctoral program or undergraduate college seniors scheduled to graduate within six months.
Chrysler sent mailings to 1.4 million students at their college addresses in April and will send a follow-up mailing to 500,000 at their home addresses in May.
